method: Alien-inspired proposals and keyword co-mention counts; no learned Alien model, novelty estimator or paid model API.

coherence_scale.1: plausible but weak or mostly selection
coherence_scale.2: direct physical/measurement rationale; session judgment, not a probability

availability_caveat: Counts measure arXiv metadata query coverage, not whether a question was asked. Synonyms, full-text omissions, corpus scope and terminology can hide prior work. Zero is not a novelty claim; errors are unknown.

known_related_prior_work.topic: Gaia photometric calibration and crowding; related to Q02 despite its zero keyword count.
Official Gaia crossmatch limitations, multiplicity and resolution; related to Q03 and match-offset questions.

selection_rule: Two highest-coherence proposals, lower successful co-mention count first, then one seeded random baseline. Unknown availability is not zero. Selection used open data and is exploratory.

proposals.question: Does astrometric fit quality track local neighbour spacing?
proposals.rationale: Nearby resolved sources can identify crowding; unresolved companions remain a different explanation.
proposals.search_query: cat:astro-ph* AND ((all:RUWE OR all:"astrometric excess noise")) AND ((all:Gaia AND (all:crowding OR all:"nearest neighbour" OR all:"nearest neighbor")))

literature.query: cat:astro-ph* AND ((all:RUWE OR all:"astrometric excess noise")) AND ((all:Gaia AND (all:crowding OR all:"nearest neighbour" OR all:"nearest neighbor")))
